body:
Sorry that we haven't replied to this in a while, but I just checked and the guide (here: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/going-further/backend-search/in-depth/backend-instantsearch/js/#on-the-backend-create-the-necessary-routes) seems to be correctly doing `client.search`, while in your code you are doing `index.search`, which isn't the same.

Since there doesn't seem to be anything wrong with the documentation, there's not really anything we can change there. Hopefully the SEO of this issue should help anyone else confused about this
